governing_concept: A sustained CPI below 1.0 indicates persistent, unfavorable cost inefficiency; the correct response is investigation and, if the condition is expected to continue, reflecting it in the forecast (e.g., EAC) rather than altering the baseline or misreading the direction of the index.
corrective_rule: CPI < 1.0 is unfavorable (over budget) in all cases; the correct response to a sustained unfavorable trend is investigate-and-forecast, never adjust the baseline to hide it.
